metadata.description: One-command install of Superpowers, Ponytail and UI UX Pro Max for Claude Code

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: forces the simplest, shortest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence: searchable database of styles, color palettes, font pairings, charts and stack guidelines for designing and reviewing UI.
